correctness.rationale: The exact polar decomposition has dr/dt=r^3[-a+gamma cos(4theta)] and dtheta/dt=r^2[omega-gamma sin(4theta)]. For 0<=omega<=gamma an invariant ray of positive cosine gives equilibrium at a=sqrt(gamma^2-omega^2) and outward flow below it, proving necessity. For a above the threshold, D=a^2+omega^2>gamma^2; with t=-gamma omega/D the quartic V=r^4+2t(x^2-y^2)(2xy) has positive SOS decomposition (1±t)/2 (A±B)^2. Independently verified its exact symbolic negative Lie derivative -dot V=4r^2 [A,B]M[A,B]^T and eigenvalue condition a(1±gamma/sqrt(D))>0. Proper strict V proves GAS including degenerate omega=gamma. Z4 averaging shows no strict quadratic if a<=gamma, while odd total degree cannot globally be positive; hence minimum strict polynomial Lyapunov degree 4 versus 2, with algebraic decay upper bound.
